name: neorgon-forge
description: Skills for taking on large work and then explaining it: task (scoped execution with delegated workstreams), debrief (the work as a deck), writeup (the work as a published post).

plugins.name: neorgon-forge
plugins.description: Three skills that share one artifact: task writes a brief while the work happens, debrief and writeup read it afterwards instead of reconstructing it from memory.
